system.name: StreamFeed Content Ranker
system.intended_purpose: Rank short-form video candidates for a user's home feed to optimise watch-time and stated-interest relevance while respecting safety filters.
system.deployment_context: Large-scale online serving; two-stage retrieval-then-ranking with per-request candidate sets of ~500 items.

governance.oversight: Users can reset interests, switch to a non-personalised chronological feed, and report content; a trust-and-safety team reviews escalations.

intended_users: Consumer end users of the home feed
out_of_scope: Amplification of content flagged by safety classifiers
Personalisation for accounts identified as minors beyond a restricted policy
risks: Engagement-optimisation amplifying borderline or sensational content

measure.test_data: Interleaving experiments and a 2% holdout of de-identified engagement logs with creator-tier and topic stratification.
measure.fairness: Creator-exposure parity tracked across creator size tiers; small-creator reach monitored against a fairness floor.
limitations: Cold-start users receive popularity-biased rankings for ~48 hours
Diversity objective is a soft constraint, not a hard guarantee

mitigations: Diversity re-ranking pass and frequency capping
DSA recommender-system option to disable personalisation
manage.monitoring: Daily systemic-risk dashboards (borderline-content prevalence, diversity, minor-safety) reviewed by the integrity team with regulator-facing reporting.
